definitions.gloss: consistency between words and actions; practicing what one preaches
definitions.explanation: The state in which what a person says matches what they actually do.

examples.japanese: {言行一致|げんこういっち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: Strive to make one's words and deeds match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言行一致|げんこういっち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He matches words with deeds, and those around him trust him.

examples.japanese: ⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{言行一致|げんこういっち}でなければ、⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}おう→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}わない→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: If a leader's words and actions don't match, subordinates won't feel like following their instructions.

notes:
A four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) made of {言行|げんこう} (words and deeds) + ⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧ (agreement, match). It is a virtue expected especially of leaders and public figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {言行一致|げんこういっち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧: to strive for consistency between words and deeds
- {言行一致|げんこういっち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person whose words and actions agree

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有言実行|ゆうげんじっこう}→有言実行：06148_yuugenjikkou⟧: following through on what one has declared — focuses on achieving stated goals
- ⟦{不言実行|ふげんじっこう}→不言実行：29294_fugenjikkou⟧: acting quietly without talking — the opposite emphasis, on deeds over declarations
